# IVD nucleus pulposus degeneration (mixed)

Bulk RNA-seq of intervertebral disc nucleus pulposus cells revealed signatures of degeneration. FOXF1 was upregulated in degenerated specimens (Table 4). PAX1 was upregulated in NP cells (Table 4). KRT18 was upregulated (Table 4).

SOX9 was downregulated in the degenerated condition (Table 4). ACAN was downregulated (Table 4). COL2A1 was downregulated (Table 4).

MMP13 was upregulated (Table 4). ADAMTS4 was upregulated (Table 4). TNF was upregulated (Table 4). IL6 was downregulated (Table 4).
